about.lead: Steel Valley Long Range is a shooting range built for long-range shooting: a 1000-metre lane and a target field with steel targets.
about.body: The target field is 160 metres wide and surrounded by berms along its entire perimeter. Steel targets placed at various distances allow training and competitions over the full length of the lane.
about.imageAlt: Placeholder illustration: a shooting lane between earth berms with steel targets in the target field

disciplines.intro: The 1000 m lane and steel targets support a range of long-range shooting disciplines.

items.name: Precision Rifle (PRS)
items.description: Precision shooting from various positions and supports at steel targets over changing distances, under time pressure.

items.name: F-Class
items.description: Precision prone shooting from a rest at long distances.

items.name: NRL Hunter
items.description: NRL Hunter is a field-shooting sport built around realistic hunting scenarios. You engage steel targets at unknown distances from natural field positions, using the very same skills that make a capable, ethical hunter.

items.name: Training and courses
items.description: Sessions for shooters who want to start or develop their long-range shooting.
